exposure: frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) cycles after preimplantation genetic testing (PGT)
Endometrial preparation groups: assisted natural cycle, hormone replacement treatment cycle
cohort: 2332 patients with regular menstrual cycles undergoing frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) cycles after preimplantation genetic testing (PGT)
finding: Assisted natural cycle and hormone replacement treatment cycle for endometrial preparation in patients undergoing a PGT-FET cycle involving a single blastocyst transfer result in comparable rates of clinical pregnancy and live birth, but assisted natural cycle is associated with lower risks of pregnancy complications and adverse obstetric outcomes.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rate was significantly higher in the hormone replacement treatment cycle group compared to the assisted natural cycle group.
